snippet.description:
What did Anthropology Optional aspirants tell Karandeep Singh Sir after appearing for the UPSC CSE 2026 Mains Anthropology paper?

In this video, LevelUp IAS students share their immediate feedback after the Anthropology Optional paper, reflecting on Karandeep Sir’s lectures, notes, concepts and exam-oriented preparation. Several students discuss how topics and questions in the paper connected with what they had studied through his classes and notes.

Karandeep Singh Sir, Director at LevelUp IAS and a popular UPSC Anthropology Optional faculty, has built his teaching around conceptual clarity, relevant examples, value addition, answer writing and understanding the demand of the UPSC paper.

Watch the reactions and feedback from students after UPSC Mains 2026 Anthropology Optional.
